title: SEC1: setContactBlocked lacks in-flight request deduplication
description: setContactBlocked() updates the local contacts Map optimistically and re-renders immediately. If two rapid calls arrive (user double-clicks or second client), both JMAP requests will proceed in parallel. If the first succeeds and the second fails, the local Map state may diverge from server state. The button is disabled during the request, but does not guard against multiple concurrent calls from different sources. Consider adding a per-contact in-flight flag or debounce. Phase 1 limitation: acceptable if documented as a known race, but maintainers should be aware a concurrent request can leave UI inconsistent.
